title: Public holiday
description: One record: one public, bank or school holiday in one country (nationwide or in some of its subdivisions), for one date range. Voyager use: events and tips (closures, crowds and price spikes on holidays).

name.description: Holiday name in English, as published.

local_name.description: Holiday name in the country's own language, as published.

type.description: `public` = statutory day off; `bank` = banks closed; `optional` = observed by some; `school` = school holidays (crowded attractions, family travel peaks).

end_date.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD); equal to `start_date` for a one-day holiday.

half_day.description: True if only half the day is a holiday.

nationwide.description: True if the holiday applies to the whole country; false if only to `subdivisions`.

code.description: Subdivision code as published (ISO 3166-2 where the source uses it, e.g. "DE-BY").

subdivisions.description: Subdivisions (states, regions, cantons, school zones) it applies to when not nationwide.

comment.description: The source's own note on the holiday, if any.

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site, booking or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
